code: (()=>{const c=window.__groundCanvas;const x=c.getContext('2d');const {width:W,height:H}=c;const d=x.getImageData(0,0,W,H).data;const GX=16,GY=9;const grid=Array.from({length:GY},()=>new Array(GX).fill(0));let tot=0;const samp=new Map();for(let y=0;y<H;y++){for(let px=0;px<W;px++){const i=(y*W+px)*4;const r=d[i],g=d[i+1],b=d[i+2];const mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b),dd=mx-mn;if(!dd)continue;let h;if(mx===r)h=60*(((g-b)/dd)%6);else if(mx===g)h=60*((b-r)/dd+2);else h=60*((r-g)/dd+4);if(h<0)h+=360;const s=mx?dd/mx:0;if(s>0.30&&h>=0&&h<32&&mx>40){tot++;const gx=Math.floor(px/W*GX),gy=Math.floor(y/H*GY);grid[gy][gx]++;const k=gx+','+gy;if(!samp.has(k))samp.set(k,[px,y,'#'+[r,g,b].map(n=>n.toString(16).padStart(2,'0')).join(''),h.toFixed(1),s.toFixed(2)]);}}}const cells=[];for(let y=0;y<GY;y++)for(let px=0;px<GX;px++)if(grid[y][px]>0)cells.push([grid[y][px],px,y,samp.get(px+','+y)]);cells.sort((a,b)=>b[0]-a[0]);return JSON.stringify({W,H,tot,top:cells.slice(0,6)});})()
